//: Files that may start processes or run code in a new thread. See docs/guides/checks.md (process-starts).

packages/adapters/sandbox-host/src/progr.reason: Asks an installed program such as claude for its version. It refuses names with a slash and looks only in absolute PATH folders of the launcher's environment, which no skill sets.

packages/adapters/sandbox-srt/src/machin.reason: Probes whether bubblewrap starts and may create user namespaces. It runs only bwrap with fixed arguments.

packages/adapters/sandbox-srt/src/srt-ru.reason: Starts sandbox-runtime's srt with Node to run a session's program inside the fence. srtRunner.run itself refuses a program, argument or folder under a skill's scripts/ folder before anything starts, so no caller gets round it.

packages/adapters/system-node/src/run-pr.reason: Reads the process table with /bin/ps or Windows PowerShell for halonic doctor's resource report.
